reviews.text:
The perfect place to bring your pups, such attention to detail!
The best place to take your dogs, they treated us like family!

What a great place! They handle dogs with care, it looks like a luxurious spa and its the first place where I didn’t have to correct the haircut for my bernedoodle myself after. Prices are similar to other grooming places in cdmx but service is superior!
Excellent service, everyone is very friendly, my dog ​​looked great and left happy, I highly recommend it 👍 …
Highly recommended! My dog ​​is special, haha, and they treated her like a queen. They returned her to me calm and beautiful! Thank you so much, ladies!
Excellent service, my dogs left very happy and handsome 😍 …

Amazing care and loving treatment for the furry ones!!

We always come back.

I decided to try Petunia because it had such great reviews here, and I wasn't disappointed.

The staff are wonderful, and you can tell they treat the pets with so much love. My dog ​​used to make such a fuss when we got to the bathing place, but now she's so calm knowing she's about to get a bath.

I love that they send me photos and videos every time I bathe her. I feel like what makes the animals feel so secure is that they always see the same people, and there are never more than two dogs there at once. It's a small, well-maintained space, which I think also makes them feel more secure.

I'm so grateful to have found this place! Don't hesitate to take your furry friends here!

I loved the place!
Highly recommended, my dog ​​left PETUNIA GROOMING & SPA super happy 🙂😉 excellent service and attention. …
Excellent treatment for your pets, 100% recommended place.

I highly recommend this place; the facilities are lovely and they offer personalized service.

My baby looked absolutely gorgeous, super relaxed, with silky soft fur and a delicious scent. 🐶🩷✨

Thank you to the entire Petunia Grooming & Spa team for your kindness and excellent service! 🐾❤️

I took my dog ​​to Petunia and the experience was simply amazing.

From the moment we walked in, they made us feel incredibly welcome. The place is clean, organized, and you can see the love they put into their work.

Vicky took great care of me; she was kind, attentive, and very professional. She explained the entire process and treated my dog ​​with so much love and patience, which means everything to me. You can tell she loves what she does.

When they handed him back to me, I couldn't believe how beautiful he looked: perfectly groomed, smelling wonderful, and happy. They've definitely earned my trust, and I'll be back without hesitation.

Highly recommended! 🐾

I'm so happy with the service my Bimba received. She doesn't like baths outside the house; she gets very nervous. However, she left very happy, with her fur super soft and smelling wonderful. We'll definitely be regular customers. You can tell that the people who work there love animals and enjoy what they do ❤️🙂‍↔️
P.S. I don't know if it was a coincidence or if they schedule it that way, but I got the impression that the appointment time was exclusively for her. In other words, they dedicate two hours exclusively to your pet.

It was the best experience we've had in the city. We live in Polanco and were looking for a more relaxed service for Lex because she gets very stressed. The team is top-notch—professional, very attentive, caring, and patient.
Lexi really enjoyed her experience.

My Memin came out very relaxed. He's getting on in years and all this grooming stuff scares him; he gets very nervous and wants to run away since he's used to bathing at home!
He enjoyed it and looked very handsome. We would definitely go back! 🥰

My dad looked so cute, I wish he could stay there all the time, but I asked for a toothbrush for the first time, and they gave him a "scissor cut" even though I didn't ask for that. When I left it, there was a "owner's note" or something like that, and I wrote "nice cut." The star package they have there says it has a "hygienic cut," and when I asked the girl if they had brushed his teeth, they said no. I was disappointed with that part of the service.
I don't doubt they treated my little one well; I just had that bad experience here. I brought him here because it has a good rating on Google Maps. Which meant I traveled a long way to get him here :(

They are the best and most loving with our four-legged children. Personally, "Baby" came out super happy and relaxed, and of course, we were the happiest to see him so lively. We'll definitely be back in about 3 weeks :)
Thank you for your hospitality!
Petunia Grooming Spa is a balm for the soul of our beloved pets. Lottie and Coco loved it, we're already on board ❤️❤️

Mila is 11 years old and Puppy suffers from anxiety. My girls left happy and relaxed. The care they received was exceptional. They have products for sensitive skin and most importantly…I LOVED HOW THEY DID THEIR HANDS!! 🥰🥰 …
Excellent service, top-notch customer service! Highly recommended!
100/100 My babies turned out beautiful and very happy ❤️
They gave my fur baby a great cut, spa & shampoo! Great service! Super friendly and I’ve never seen my dog happier when I went to pick him up! Very happy with these guys and definitely recommend!!
Excellent service and care for Luke! He definitely enjoyed the massage and the bath. Thank you so much!
Superb service :) They always treat my dog ​​wonderfully. And she leaves happy.

TERRIBLE. IF YOU LOVE YOUR PET, DON'T TAKE THEM.
The staff is rude and uneducated. They didn't complete the grooming service for my puppy because, according to them, he was biting. He's a three-month-old Shih Tzu who doesn't even have fully formed teeth yet, and it was his first bath. He's a very calm and friendly dog. I asked them to be patient because he was a baby and it was his first bath, and to say he "bites" means they had already stressed him out enough.
The prices are extremely expensive, and there's not even an apology for not finishing the service; all they want is to get paid. They have zero empathy for dealing with customers, much less dogs. The groomer doesn't even say good morning; she only asks what she wants to know, and she handed my dog ​​back to me with a bad attitude and didn't even bother to put his collar back on.
Excellent place for dogs 👌 …

It was my first time at Petunia, and my puppy arrived super nervous. When I picked him up, he was so happy! They gave him back to me with a gorgeous haircut and smelling amazing. They treated him so well, and the staff were so patient. I can't wait to take him back! ❤️
Excellent service!!! Chester is happy
Had an incredible experience at Petunia Grooming Salon. The owner was so kind and took great care of my maine coon cat, mister man. Highly recommend! Will definitely be back. Muchas Gracias! 🐾 …
My dog ​​was very relaxed, and they left his fur super silky, better than anywhere else. No knots and smelling great.
I loved it because they had a lot of experience with Pomeranians and they took great care of my puppy's fur.
closed at 5:31pm even though their google profile says that they’re open until 6pm. Took me 30 minutes to walk here.

Milo usually doesn't like baths and is afraid of them. At Petunia Grooming & Spa, they treated him wonderfully, with personalized service and great care. He loved the spa and left smelling amazing!

Thank you so much for taking care of my fur baby! 🤣
Excellent service and a lovely team!
Excellent service, great location, and impeccable treatment. Ophelia leaves her bath happy and relaxed (even smelling great!). They know her and try to adapt to her personality. I recommend it 100%!
The best place to pamper my dog ​​Paris. They treat him like royalty, and even though he's very timid, he always enjoys his bath and spa treatments. 100% recommended!

We had a great experience with Petunia Grooming. We contacted them at the last minute because our dog had gotten dirty at the park. They were able to see us quickly. They took great care of Henry and did an excellent job. We'll definitely be bringing them back every time we visit the city!

Everything about this place was amazing. From the moment we arrived and asked, they were incredibly kind and friendly. We made an appointment and brought our puppy in, and the service was perfect from start to finish. She left clean and happy 🥰 …
Amazing service!!! They pamper the puppies so much, I loved it!
My dog ​​was super clean and happy after her bath 🥺 I loved that they treated her with so much love, affection, and patience! Everything was perfect 10/10 …

An excellent option for anyone looking to have their pet groomed. I was visiting Mexico City and our dog really needed a bath/cut. I absolutely loved how they treated my dog and the cut he came out with! The staff is amazing with excellent customer service and great at grooming! The facilities are modern and a huge plus is that they do not have cages. The salon is calm and relaxing and does not have the chaos you can find at other groomers. Honestly, it seems they really put the animal first when doing the groom. I can’t recommend them enough!
Highly recommended, excellent place! My dog ​​looked gorgeous ❤️
Excellent spa for our pets! The attention and treatment my kitten received was incredible. Wishing them much success! Don't hesitate to visit them! 🙌🏼 …
Excellent care and service. My dog ​​relaxed despite being very nervous, and she smelled wonderful. Definitely a safe place for your furry friend.
Excellent work! You can see the love with which they treated my puppy. Thank you so much for everything. He looks super handsome in his rock star vest! 🫶🏽❤️🐶 …
We took our cats Fergie and Jackie to Petunia for grooming and they were pampered with so much love. Excellent place and the service was the best. Definitely highly recommended! 100%

They treated my baby very well.
Excellent service.
Incredible service, very professional and respectful to the dogs. 100% recommended
